Theodred II
A medieval Bishop of Elmham whose consecration date is unknown and who died between 995 and 997.

Bishop of Elmham
A medieval ecclesiastical title and position held by Theodred II.

Elmham
A geographic location associated with the bishopric held by Theodred II.

data.entity_name: The Wonderful World of Captain Kuhio
data.content:
The Wonderful World of Captain Kuhio
A film released in Japan on 10 October 2009.

Japan
The country where the film was released.

10 October 2009
The specific date of the film's release in Japan.

Lambert
Margrave of Tuscany, count and duke of Lucca, second son of Adalbert II of Tuscany and Bertha, died after 938.

Adalbert II of Tuscany
Father of Lambert and Guy.<SEP>Husband of Bertha and Margrave of Tuscany by marriage.

Bertha
Mother of Lambert and Guy, daughter of Lothair II of Lotharingia.<SEP>Countess of Arles and Margravine of Tuscany, daughter of Lothair II, who served as regent of Lucca and Tuscany from 915 to 916.<SEP>Illegitimate daughter of Lothair II, known for her beauty and spirit, and wife of Theobald of Arles.

Lothair II of Lotharingia
Father of Bertha.

Guy
Elder brother of Lambert, former count and duke of Lucca and margrave of Tuscany, died in 928 or 929 without heirs.

Hugh
King of Italy, half-brother of Guy and Lambert, disowned Lambert in 931.

Boso
Brother of Lambert and Guy, received Tuscany and Lucca from Hugh.

Marozia
Widow of Guy, married by Hugh after Guy's death.

Tuscany
Region governed by Lambert as margrave, later given to Boso by Hugh.<SEP>Region where Bertha served as margravine and regent.

Lucca
City and familial possession held by Lambert as count and duke, later given to Boso.<SEP>City where Bertha died and where she served as regent.

Italy
Kingdom ruled by Hugh.

Etan Boritzer
An American writer of children's literature, yoga teacher, and speaker known for the "What is?" book series.

What is God?
A book by Etan Boritzer first published in 1989, known for its universalist views and controversy among religious fundamentalists.

What is? Series
A best-selling illustrated children's book series on character education and difficult subjects, translated into 15 languages.

Wade Junior High School
A school in the Bronx, New York, where Etan Boritzer wrote an essay at age 13.

The Bronx
A borough in New York City where Wade Junior High School is located.

New York
A state in the United States, associated with the location of Wade Junior High School.

John F. Kennedy
The former US President whose assassination was the subject of Etan Boritzer's early essay.

data.content:
New York City Department of Education
The entity that compiled and published an anthology including Etan Boritzer's essay.

Venice
A neighborhood in California where Etan Boritzer currently lives and maintains his publishing office.

California
A state in the United States where Venice is located.

data.content:
How to Get Your Book Published!
Programs by Etan Boritzer designed to help other authors get published.

The Teachings of the Buddha
A subject on which Etan Boritzer is recognized as an erudite speaker.

Lothair II
King of Lotharingia from 855 until his death, second son of Emperor Lothair I and Ermengarde of Tours.<SEP>King of Lotharingia and father of Bertha.

Lotharingia
A kingdom ruled by Lothair II from 855 until his death.<SEP>Kingdom ruled by Lothair II.<SEP>A historical region associated with the titles of Count Palatine held by Hermann I and referenced in Adolf I's name.<SEP>A kingdom ruled by Lothair II.

Lothair I
Emperor and father of Lothair II.<SEP>Carolingian Emperor of the Franks (795–855) who married Ermengarde of Tours.

Ermengarde of Tours
Mother of Lothair II and wife of Emperor Lothair I.<SEP>Daughter of Hugh of Tours and wife of Lothair I, who died on 20 March 851 and was buried in Erstein Abbey.

Teutberga
Wife of Lothair II and daughter of Boso the Elder, died in 875.

Boso the Elder
Father of Teutberga.

Hugh of Tours
Father of Ermengarde of Tours and a member of the Etichonen family.

Etichonen
A noble family to which Hugh of Tours belonged.

Thionville
The location where Ermengarde of Tours married Lothair I in October 821.

Erstein Abbey
An abbey in Elsass that received a donation from Ermengarde of Tours in 849 and where she is buried.

Elsass
The region where Erstein Abbey is located.

Theobald of Arles
Husband of Bertha and Count of Arles by marriage.<SEP>Count of Arles from the Bosonid family, son of Hucbert, and husband of Bertha.

Guy of Tuscany
Son of Bertha, whose minority prompted her regency in Lucca and Tuscany.

Waldrada
Concubine of Lothair II and mother of Bertha.

Arles
Region associated with Theobald and Bertha's title as countess.

Adolf I of Lotharingia
Count of Keldachgau and Vogt of Deutz from 1008 until 1018, and son of Hermann I Pusillus.

Keldachgau
A region or county associated with the title held by Adolf I.

Deutz
A place where Adolf I served as Vogt from 1008 until 1018.

Hermann I Pusillus
Also known as the Little Pfalzgraf, count palatine of Lotharingia, and father of Adolf I.

Waldrada Of Lotharingia
Mistress and later wife of Lothair II of Lotharingia

Lothair II Of Lotharingia
Ruler of Lotharingia who had Waldrada as his mistress and later wife

Bosonid
A noble family to which Theobald of Arles belonged.

Hucbert
Father of Theobald of Arles.

Hugh of Italy
Son of Theobald of Arles and Bertha.

Boso of Tuscany
Son of Theobald of Arles and Bertha.
